description: Revocation closure `supersession-chain` over the 20-entry toy corpus (core spec §5.1, §5.3), evaluated at the checkpoint committing the trigger.
note: The correction at entry 12 supersedes the correction at entry 6, which had replaced A with A2. Core spec §5.1: the later correction's seeds are the original A *and every prior superseded replacement*, here A2 — but never its own replacement A3 (hmac-sha256:72f6f4c6c0a09ac7610d6ce218218c3e8623a8b2bb502f41821d99af2ab82670). Seeding A2 is what pulls in S1' (entry 7) and W (entry 10); seeding only A would silently leave both outside the affected set, and seeding A3 would be wrong in the other direction. W is reached through the input-set tree of entry 10, so the closure is only computable by a verifier holding the committed leaf material (§3.5).
